settings.heading: Send the Details. Get a Clear Next Step.
settings.copy: Share artwork details, order questions, quantities, deadline needs or business-branding plans.

settings.heading: A Better Answer Starts With Clear Details
settings.content:
Include the product type, Richardson 112 or PTS30 preference when relevant, estimated quantity, artwork status, patch material, colors, deadline and shipping or pickup preference.

For custom orders, use the dedicated order form so all build details arrive together.

settings.question: Where do I send a custom hat request?
settings.answer: Use the Custom Hats page for Richardson 112 or Richardson PTS30 orders.

settings.question: Where can I review quantity pricing?
settings.answer: Visit the Bulk Orders page. Model-specific price mapping still requires client confirmation.
